name: Codex
description: Codex's New Tab (what should we build, in the project you pick), threads by project in the sidebar, and Codex's rate limits in each chat's Session Info.

scopes.agent_chat:read: Read your agent chats, to list threads by project.
scopes.usage_app:read: Read the rate limits left on your Codex accounts from cmux's Usage app.
scopes.workspace:read: Know which workspace is open, to mark its thread.
scopes.workspace:write: Show a thread's workspace when you click it.
scopes.actions:run: Start a Codex chat from the New Tab, or open a thread in a tab.
